Projects

ZI-VO

Designed and shipped a three-tier platform for location-based advertising: creators pay to publish media campaigns to users within defined geographic radii; the backend scores and assigns content via background jobs, tracks views, and triggers quiz-based reward allocation. Frontend: Expo Router mobile app with location permissions, full-screen media playback, and TanStack Query; Next.js 15 creator portal with Stripe Elements and campaign management. Backend: Laravel 12 REST API with Sanctum, Horizon queues, Spatie Media Library on S3, Expo push notifications, and Companies House verification for business creators.
